title: In ip_stack, there is a possible out of bounds read due to improper input validation. (CVE-2026-68590)
description: A vulnerability in ip_stack allows an out of bounds read due to improper input validation. This flaw can be exploited remotely without user interaction if a user equipment (UE) connects to a rogue base station controlled by an attacker. Exploitation could result in a denial of service condition.
